description: 국토교통부_버스노선 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 버스 노선 정보는 특정 지역(시·도) 내 대중교통 서비스를 이해하고 분석하는 데 핵심적인 데이터를 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 버스노선정보, 대중교통데이터, 운행경로, 버스운행정보, 정류장경유정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
